parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The ID of the request source. Set the value to sas.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUID of the asset.

>  You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of assets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas query-attack-count --from sas --lang zh --source-ip 175.0.XX.XX --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas QueryAttackCount --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '175.0.XX.XX' --Lang zh --From sas --Uuids '1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000'
